name: ctx3k-fixed
hypothesis: PREDICTION (after the compaction-hysteresis fix, same 3000-token limit and keep_recent=4 as the earlier ctx3k run: 90% baseline, 77% ctx3k, 31 summary compactions and 41.8 steps per run): the limit is still unreachable by compaction (828 prompt tokens + verbatim recent tool outputs exceed the 2100 threshold), but the cost is bounded: summary compactions per run fall to <= 8, mean steps to <= 20, `max_steps` failures mostly disappear, and the pass rate returns to within 10 points of the 90% baseline. If steps stay high the cause is something other than the trigger.
